blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Show-cause orders were issued to certain members of the House prosecution panel for possible violation of the sub judice rule, Presiding Officer Chiz Escudero said Wednesday. “Before we adjourn today’s trial, the presiding officer, in accordance with the court’s 26 August 2026 directive regarding the strict enforcement of Rule 18 of the Rules of Procedure in impeachment trial on sub judice, the court issued show-cause orders to certain members of the House prosecution panel,” Escudero said. He made the directive on the 25th day of the impeachment trial against Vice President Sara Duterte. The clerk of court was […]...
